messages:
mina: FYI ran the v3.0-int8 smoke+ab compare vs v2.9-fp16. big perf wins but the new semantic-similarity metric (cosine-based) diverged vs our legacy BLEU-like metric on the faq-answer slice.
peter: interesting. numbers?
mina: faq-answer (short Q/A): n=5200; mrr delta = -0.011 p=0.04; bleu-like delta = -0.002 p=0.28; semsim delta = -0.024 p=0.008. latency p50 -30% cost/token -33%.
zhou: so semsim is stronger signal and flags a bigger regression. our gates only reference MRR/bleu historically, not semsim.
eval-bot: automated eval: slice=faq-answer; n=5198; delta_mrr=-0.0109; p_mrr=0.038; delta_bleu=-0.0021; p_bleu=0.274; delta_semsim=-0.0236; p_semsim=0.008; CI_semsim=[-0.037,-0.010]; notes=semsim sensitivity higher for paraphrase prompts. link: https://console.redwood/testing/runs/2026-05-01/2160000001
peter: I don't want to ignore semsim, but it's newer and noisier across some templates. We need a principled way to incorporate orthogonal semantic metrics into gates.
mina: proposal: introduce "metric-roles": primary (MRR), orthogonal (BLEU, EM), and semantic (SEMSIM). Gate logic: autofallback if primary fails AND (orthogonal OR semantic) also fails OR if semantic fails beyond a higher bar (e.g., delta<-0.02 && p<0.01) to catch pure semantic regressions.
zhou: plus require sample dedupe and min_unique_questions to 2000 for faq slice. duplicates were ~12% here.
peter: also add a decaying-trust weight for new metrics: first 50 runs of semsim are considered beta; failing semsim alone during beta should open replicate-run instead of autofallback. After 50 stable runs we promote it to full gate.
mina: config sketch: ```
"metric_roles": {"primary":"mrr","orthogonal":["bleu","exact"],"semantic":"semsim"},
"gates": [
  {"name":"faq-core","slice":"faq-answer","primary_thresh":-0.01,"primary_p":0.05,"orthogonal_thresh":-0.01,"semantic_thresh":-0.02,"semantic_p":0.01}
],
"new_metric_beta": {"metric":"semsim","beta_runs":50,"beta_action":"replicate_then_manual"}
```
zhou: I like the beta ramp. Also add a rule: if economics wins (latency>20% & cost>25%) allow semsim-only failures to go to replicate_then_manual rather than immediate autofallback.
peter: release-bot, can we wire semsim into the alerting groups but mark it beta for now?
release-bot: alerting updated: semsim=beta -> will create replicate jobs on semsim-only fails during beta. pager will be triggered if replicate confirms.
mina: action items: 1) add semsim metric to metrics catalog and mark beta; 2) patch rollout-config with metric_roles + gate logic; 3) add dedupe + min_unique_questions=2000; 4) schedule replicate run for this seed and tag beta-semsim.
zhou: I'll open the PR for rollout-config; include historical-run references and a note about decaying-trust.
peter: good. once PR lands re-run the preflight with dedupe locked and see if semsim signal persists. if replicate confirms, we'll treat semsim as a real regression and block.
mina: thanks all 44d
